mapper.select: SELECT member_id, site_code, login_id, member_name, email, COALESCE(last_login_at, created_at) AS base_at FROM tb_member WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(last_login_at, created_at) < #{cutoff} ORDER BY base_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_member_dormant (member_id, member_seq, site_id, site_code, login_id, password, password_changed_at, role_ids, member_name, nickname, email, email_hash, phone, phone_hash, birth_date, birth_year, gender, di, di_hash, parent_name, parent_di, parent_di_hash, address_zipcode, address, address_detail, join_type, status, last_login_at, last_access_at, dormant_at, dormant_reason, created_by, created_ip, created_at) SELECT member_id, member_seq, site_id, site_code, login_id, password, password_changed_at, role_ids, member_name, nickname, email, email_hash, phone, phone_hash, birth_date, birth_year, gender, di, di_hash, parent_name, parent_di, parent_di_hash, address_zipcode, address, address_detail, join_type, status, last_login_at, last_access_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{reason}, created_by, created_ip, created_at FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO tb_member_withdraw (member_id, member_seq, site_id, site_code, login_id_hash, di_hash, withdraw_at, withdraw_reason, withdraw_status, retention_expire_at, legal_basis, created_by, created_ip, created_at) SELECT member_id, member_seq, site_id, site_code, SHA2(login_id, 256), di_hash, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{reason}, #{withdrawType}, #{retentionExpireAt}, #{legalBasis}, #{actor}, #{clientIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

INSERT INTO tb_member_withdraw (member_id, member_seq, site_id, site_code, login_id_hash, di_hash, withdraw_at, withdraw_reason, withdraw_status, retention_expire_at, legal_basis, created_by, created_ip, created_at) SELECT member_id, member_seq, site_id, site_code, SHA2(login_id, 256), di_hash, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{reason}, #{withdrawType}, #{retentionExpireAt}, #{legalBasis}, #{actor}, #{clientIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tb_member_dormant WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_member SET member_name = NULL, nickname = NULL, email = NULL, email_hash = NULL, email_verified_yn = 'N', phone = NULL, phone_hash = NULL, birth_date = NULL, birth_year = NULL, gender = NULL, di = NULL, di_hash = NULL, parent_name = NULL, parent_di = NULL, parent_di_hash = NULL, address_zipcode = NULL, address = NULL, address_detail = NULL, -- password 는 NOT NULL 이라 비울 수 없다(실측). BCrypt 형식이 아닌 값을 넣어 -- 어떤 입력과도 매칭되지 않게 한다 — 해시를 남겨 두는 것보다 낫다 password = '-', role_ids = NULL, status = 'SUSPENDED', delete_yn = 'Y', updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
